title: Aperitivo Hour at Trofeo Estate
summary: Half-price wines and cellar door tastings every Friday in winter at the historic Trofeo Estate chapel and winery. Aperitivo-style evenings from 4pm.
accessibilityNotes: Historic chapel venue; contact Trofeo for specific access requirements
weatherDependency: Indoor chapel setting with outdoor terrace option
nearbyAttractions: Ten Minutes by Tractor; Main Ridge Dairy; Crittenden Estate
suggestedItineraryPairing: Trofeo Friday aperitivo at 4pm, drive the Red Hill wine trail on the way home, dinner in the area or take a picnic
editorVerdict: Half-price wines in a converted chapel on a Friday afternoon. The Peninsula doesn't really do better than this for a quick after-work knock.
editorNote:
Trofeo Estate runs aperitivo hour every Friday throughout winter — half-price wines and cellar door tastings in the estate's historic chapel and winery from 4pm to 6pm. It's the Peninsula at its most Italian.

No booking required, just show up. The chapel setting makes it feel more considered than a standard cellar door tasting, and the half-price pricing means you can try broadly without watching the tab.

Good as a standalone Friday afternoon stop or as the kickoff to a wine trail weekend. Pair with the Main Ridge area wineries nearby.
